_meta.note: Every value here is quoted or tabulated from the documents keyed in SOURCES.md. Items marked "derived" are arithmetic read-offs of a quoted formula or table, not outside knowledge.

business_day_definition.text: A Business Day is any day on which the sum of the CIPs for those Index Commodities that are open for trading is greater than 50%; prior-year CIPs are used on days up to and including the CIM Determination Date.

roll_days.index_roll_period: Business Days 6 through 10 of every month ("Roll Period")
roll_days.hedge_roll_period: Business Days 5 through 9 of every month ("Hedge Roll Period")
roll_days.day_counting: Business Day k of the calendar month, counted with the BCOM Business Day definition (CIP-weighted >50% open), not the CME calendar.
roll_days.source: SRC-M2026 s.3.1 p.31 (Roll Period); Appendix A p.38-39 (Hedge Roll Period, Roll Period); s.3.3 p.34

roll_fractions.derived_hedge_timing: derived: the BD6 index return (close BD5 -> close BD6) is earned 20% on WAV2, so a replicating position must hold 20% in WAV2 from the close of BD5; likewise 40%..100% from the closes of BD6..BD9. This matches the methodology's Hedge Roll Period BD5-9.
roll_fractions.source: SRC-M2026 s.3.1 p.31-32; Appendix C Table 13 p.42

rebalance_days.rule: The January annual reweight is executed inside the January Roll Period: WAV1 keeps the prior year's CIMs (CIM_last_year) until the end of the January roll period; WAV2 uses the new CIMs. The index shifts from WAV1 to WAV2 on BD6-BD10 of January (hedge execution BD5-BD9).
rebalance_days.quote: CIM_last_year continues to be used for the calculation of WAV1 until the end of the roll period falling in the month of January
rebalance_days.press_release_wording: 2026: "will take effect during the January 2026 Roll Period" (SRC-PR2026)
rebalance_days.source: SRC-M2026 s.2.7 p.27 and footnote 19; s.3.1; s.3.3 p.34

rebalance_fractions.value: Same as the roll: 20% per Business Day over five Business Days (index BD6-10; hedge BD5-9); in January an MDE never doubles up - the affected contract is spread over five non-disrupted Business Days.
rebalance_fractions.source: SRC-M2026 s.3.3 p.34 and Table 11 p.35

cim_determination_rule.rule: Fourth Business Day of January ("CIM Determination Date"), or as otherwise determined under s.3.3.
cim_determination_rule.prices_used: Settlement Prices (converted to USD) of the Lead Future for January for each Designated Contract on the CIM Determination Date (FPD_S).
cim_determination_rule.formula: ICIM = CIP*1000/FPD_S; Adjustment Factor = WAV1(CIM_last_year, FPD_S)/1000; CIM_new_year = ICIM*AF, rounded to 8 dp; fixed for the year.
cim_determination_rule.mde_on_cim_date: Limit event: use that day's settlement. Exchange fails to publish: use first prior Business Day without an MDE.

designated_contract_schedule.meaning: Column = calendar month; value = Lead Future contract month for that month. Next Future = the next month's column (December -> January column). In the Roll Period the index moves from Lead to Next.

designated_contracts_and_exchanges.CME_Group_divisions: Glossary: NYMEX, COMEX and CBOT are divisions of the CME Group; Live Cattle and Lean Hogs are printed with exchange "CME". These four exchange labels are treated as CME Group.
designated_contracts_and_exchanges.copper_note: BCOM uses COMEX copper prices but LME copper volume for the liquidity percentage.
designated_contracts_and_exchanges.exchange_naming_by_version: M2016 prints ICE (Brent) and NYBOT (softs); M2018 ICE Europe / ICE US; M2020+ ICE Futures Europe / ICE Futures U.S.
designated_contracts_and_exchanges.source: SRC-M2026 s.2.2 Table 2 p.13; Appendix A p.37-39; SRC-M2016/M2018/M2020 Table 2

holiday_rule.market_disruption_event: (a) termination/suspension/material limitation of trading in a Lead or Next Future; (b) settlement at the maximum permitted price change; (c) exchange fails to publish settlement; (d) for an LME contract, a Business Day on which the LME is not open.
holiday_rule.feb_to_dec: An MDE during the Hedge Roll Period postpones that commodity's daily roll to the next non-disrupted Business Day; other commodities unaffected; period extended only if the MDE hits the scheduled final day.
holiday_rule.january: Rolling or rebalancing always occurs over five non-disrupted Business Days at 20% per day; the January Hedge Roll Period is extended until the affected contract finishes; no doubling up.
holiday_rule.source: SRC-M2026 s.3.3 p.34-35 (Table 11). The s.3.3 Hedge Roll Period (BD5-9) wording and the January five-day rule were checked present in M2016, M2017, M2018, M2020, M2021, M2022, M2023, M2024 (hedge period only), M2025, M2026; the MDE definition (a)-(d) was read in M2026 only.

repo_cross_check.repo_claim: BCOM s.2.8 rolls NG over the closes of business days 5-9 (BD5-9)
repo_cross_check.finding: Consistent with the methodology's Hedge Roll Period (BD5-9, defined in Appendix A and s.3.3), and with the index Roll Period BD6-10 of s.3.1. Section 2.8 itself holds the contract calendar, not the roll days.

conflicts_and_flags: Spec 3.2 says the January rebalance runs over the 6th-10th business day: that is the INDEX Roll Period; the methodology's Hedge Roll Period (where a replicating hedger trades) is BD5-9.
CIM date labels inside methodology versions disagree with each other (2018, 2019 label in M2020, 2022); see cim_determination_rule.
